{{Top|leg}}
A '''push-up''' was a common calisthenics exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms. At under three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age, while living on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was expected to complete this exercise in his room as part of his training, while listening to the sound of a bell. Maul would alternate between one-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] and two-armed variations of this exercise.
